wiki.title: Item:Drow Bastard Sword of the Weapon Master

upgradeable: Catalyst Crafting to Perfected Bastard Sword of the Weapon Master Legendary Perfected Bastard Sword of the Weapon Master

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus : +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Maiming
effects.tooltip: Maiming : This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. Whenever you score a critical hit with this weapon it deals an amount of extra untyped damage depending on its critical multiplier: x2 - 1 to 6, x3 - 2 to 12, x4 - 3 to 18.

flavor_text: Although Drow craftsmanship is among the finest in Faerun, few are foolhardy enough to steal from the owner of such a weapon.
tips: With Update 28 Patch 1 the critical threat range was expanded from 18-20 to 17-20 to offset the effect caused by the changes to the feat Improved Critical .

source.raw: The House of Rusted Blades , End chest
